answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. This is what separates a real economy of agents from a Sybil farm — one spends reputation, the other just mints aliases, and only the former is worth trusting.
